scope: Raw signed PUTs on two objects inside one unique _mobile-acceptance child prefix; all objects deleted. No original prefix object, key envelope, CORS or bucket versioning setting was changed.
runtime: Bun 1.3.14; real Tencent COS endpoint; not Hermes, native UI or device evidence

remediation.conditionalCreate: Official COS endpoints use x-cos-forbid-overwrite:true after a read-only versioning check on every conditional creation; only 409 FileAlreadyExists maps to conflict.
remediation.conditionalUpdate: COS PUT ignores standard If-Match. The adapter refuses COS atomic conditional updates before any PUT; key rotation and passphrase changes requiring CAS retain their prior remote object.
remediation.bun: Both conditional modes delegate to the shared fetch adapter; the HEAD followed by unconditional PUT approximation is removed.
remediation.compatibility: Normal existing-object reads and unconditional sync writes remain available. Official COS endpoint detection is independent of virtual-host addressing; a declared COS custom domain fails conditional writes because its capabilities cannot be verified.
remediation.latency: Each COS conditional create incurs one extra signed GET Bucket versioning; there is no long-lived capability cache.
remediation.administrativeBoundary: The COS API does not combine the versioning-state check and object creation into one request. An administrator enabling or suspending bucket versioning concurrently between GET and PUT remains outside the atomic-create guarantee; keep versioning never-enabled for conditional creation. No bucket settings were changed for validation.

claims: COS Enabled/Suspended/unrecognized versioning and missing permission cause zero PUTs
COS atomic updates cause zero network requests
Bun concurrent creates have one winner and one conflict without HEAD
COS drop-key rotation and passphrase change perform zero PUTs and preserve cached and remote keys
